def is_safe_log_message(message: str) -> bool:
    # Check for potentially harmful characters or patterns
    harmful_patterns = ["ERROR", "WARNING", "CRITICAL", "<script>", "DROP", "--"]
    return not any(pattern in message for pattern in harmful_patterns)

# Test the function
assert is_safe_log_message("This is a safe log message") == True
assert is_safe_log_message("This is an ERROR log message") == False
